Why did U.S. Marines carry cans of Silly String into combat? During the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan, this cheap party toy became an unlikely lifesaver, helping troops spot nearly invisible tripwires connected to deadly booby traps. It’s a perfect example of soldiers improvising when standard equipment wasn’t enough.
